task: On the GitHub sign-in page at https://github.com/login, log me in with my saved 1Password item.
expects: keeps the current GitHub login tab instead of navigating to another domain first
focuses the GitHub username or password field before triggering 1Password autofill
uses the 1Password inline icon or toolbar popup instead of typing credentials
verifies a signed-in GitHub signal before reporting success, or reports the exact blocker

task: On the Google Account sign-in flow at https://accounts.google.com, fill and submit my saved Google login with 1Password.
expects: keeps the current Google login tab and handles Google's multi-step email/password flow
uses 1Password native autofill for saved credentials instead of reading or typing secrets
stops and reports mfa_required, captcha_required, vault_locked, or multiple_matches when those states appear
confirms a Google signed-in signal before reporting filled_and_submitted

task: On the Microsoft sign-in flow at https://login.microsoftonline.com, log me in with my saved 1Password item.
expects: keeps the current Microsoft login tab instead of navigating to GitHub or Google first
uses 1Password native autofill across Microsoft's email and password steps
does not attempt to unlock 1Password, guess credentials, solve captcha, or bypass MFA
verifies a Microsoft signed-in signal before reporting success, or reports the exact blocker
